question:

(A) [0.7682, 0.0643, 0.9882, 0.2843]
(B) [0.1028, 0.4979, 0.3228, 0.7179]
(C) [0.4118, 0.5677, 0.6318, 0.7877]
(D) No region lies inside a mirror.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
